scope: Exploratory fixed-seed native episode0 trace. Additional observation wrapper only; no evaluator or core source edits. Timing excludes instrumentation.
action_order_reconstruction: Replay the declared independent engine RNG default_rng(SeedSequence([270920260,7201])), consuming one permutation of len(active_agents) per step; ordered agents reconstructed from each pre-action state.
